recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reword current source merely to match older resolution text exactly; the later personal/functional split explains the current wording while retaining the approved directionality.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA issue asking to clarify RelatedPerson.relationship directionality, with approved text saying the directionality is from RelatedPerson to Patient and examples using PRN/MTH when the RelatedPerson is the patient's parent or mother.
initial_application: Commit 3b17466cd4311c8b261c00e1796fe76c1f303784 directly applied FHIR-26994 by adding the approved short, definition, and directionality comment to source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml. Commit 47ecaaf91a5ec157f4b45c3e094e11a966b26ed1 immediately removed a trailing period from the short description because it caused a build error.
additional_context: FHIR-19411 was an earlier Published/Persuasive same-family directionality clarification. The September 2021 PA minutes record the FHIR-26994 motion, 4-0-0 vote, and exact resolution text. A January 2021 Zulip thread shows implementer confusion over the same directionality and points to FHIR-26994. FHIR-15841 later split personal relationships from functional roles and preserved the directionality comment. FHIR-29929 is related to that split and was already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists RelatedPerson as an active resource, and source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml currently states the personal relationship of the related person to the patient and explicitly says directionality is from RelatedPerson to Patient.
